features.name: education_num_normalized
features.description: Education years normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max bounds for smooth linear margin contribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth continuous education signal directly usable by linear SVM without scale distortion

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Age normalized to [0,1] using training distribution bounds for linear separability
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth age signal on unit scale improves SVM margin geometry

features.name: capital_net_log
features.description: Log-transformed net capital (gain minus loss) shifted to handle negatives, capturing wealth signal on compressed scale
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed capital distribution into linear-friendly range, preserving wealth ordering

features.name: hours_deviation_from_fulltime
features.description: Absolute deviation of hours per week from standard 40-hour full-time work week, normalized by max deviation
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-standard work patterns; overworkers and underworkers may have distinct income profiles

features.name: hours_normalized
features.description: Hours per week normalized to [0,1] range for direct linear contribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth work hours signal on unit scale for SVM margin optimization

features.name: education_age_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized education and normalized age capturing joint human capital accumulation effect
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates a bilinear interaction term useful for linear models to capture joint education-experience effects

features.name: married_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for married-couple household status based on marital_status encoding (0=Married-civ-spouse)
features.expected_model_benefit: Married status is a strong predictor; binary feature provides clean linear decision boundary contribution

features.name: capital_activity_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for any capital market activity (nonzero gain or loss), signaling investment participation
features.expected_model_benefit: Investment activity is a strong wealth proxy; binary flag provides clean linear separability signal

features.name: high_education_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for college degree or higher (education_num >= 13, corresponding to Bachelors or above)
features.expected_model_benefit: Degree attainment threshold creates strong linear boundary contribution for income prediction

features.name: work_capital_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of normalized hours, education, and log capital gain capturing overall economic productivity
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite score approximates a linear projection of key income predictors, directly useful for SVM margin

features.name: occupation_income_potential
features.description: Semantic score from 0 to 1 reflecting the typical income potential of the occupation category encoded in the occupation field, where higher values indicate professional/managerial roles and lower values indicate service/manual labor roles
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain knowledge about occupation income tiers into a continuous score for smooth linear margin contribution

features.name: socioeconomic_composite_score
features.description: Holistic socioeconomic status score from 0 to 1 integrating education level, occupation prestige, work hours commitment, and capital activity into a single continuous severity measure of economic standing
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single smooth composite score that approximates the dominant linear direction in feature space for income prediction
